text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of an important meeting.
I spent plenty of time preparing for it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truthfully, I lacked the confidence to get the proposal approved.
My steps felt heavy as I headed toward the meeting room—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, thank goodness we didn't crash.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to space out for a bit...
Are you feeling alright?
choice_data_list: I'm sorry... I was lost in thought for a second.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry out of nowhere,
but could you close your eyes for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swayed by that gentle tone of voice,
my eyes naturally closed shut...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Unpleasant things rest upon your palm.
Difficult things, painful things, worrying things.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For unpleasant things like that...
Take this~~! Hah!
choice_data_list: (Did someone just place something in my palm...?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Behold! All your unpleasant thoughts have turned into sweet little candies!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With this, we can beat back any bad vibes!
Go ahead, take a big bite!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that furrow between your brows is gone.
That's a great expression♪
choice_data_list: Thanks, you really helped me out.
Alright, this meeting is going to go great!
Alright, this meeting should go great!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that furrow between your brows is gone.
That's a great expression♪
choice_data_list: Thanks, you really helped me out.
Alright, this meeting is going to go great!
Alright, this meeting should go great!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me add one more just to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I made a few too many cookies, so here are the leftovers.
Go on, enjoy! ♪
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, for everything.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please don't worry about it. Weren't you in a hurry with an errand to run?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Have a cookie and calm your nerves.
Go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why you looked so troubled.
Must be quite an important meeting.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we try
another good luck charm as well!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm-hm, hm-hm-hm-hm~~♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The Toughness Bar with a message is complete. Eat this, and you'll surely feel the energy surging within you!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're such a reassuring presence!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'll be praying for your meeting to go well.
Go get 'em, Trainer! ♪
